## What is happening
Since 6 April, Rascal & Co's PO-line DIFOT is **79.5%**, down from **95.5%** before (−16 pts). The target is 96%, so the gap is **−16.5 pts**. The weekly scorecard shows the same slide: it was 93.5–95.7% in weeks 8–13 and fell to **87.3%** in week 18 (87.8% in week 19).

Short deliveries are the main cause, not lateness:
- In-full is 87.2% and on-time is 92.3%.
- 5 of the 8 missed lines were short and 3 were late.
- Orders that came in short delivered only **68.6%** of the units ordered, down from 86.1% before.
- In total, **769 units** were short.

All of the misses are on the Rascal + Friends brand.

## Whose problem it is
**It's the supplier's problem.** None of the units short came from lines Baby Mart sized on a planner override, and there were no overrides at all. 7 of the 8 misses are the supplier's. These were normal orders that Rascal & Co didn't deliver in full.

The misses are concentrated in two places:
- **NSW DC:** 80.2% of the units short. Short lines there delivered 62% of the units ordered.
- **Crawler Nappies:** 75.4% of the units short. Short lines there delivered 50% of the units ordered.

The lane (domestic road, StarTrack, 14-day lead time) is not the issue. Only 7.7% of lines arrived late.

**Shelves are affected:** 12 NSW stores are SHORT of Rascal + Friends and 48 stores are LOW across all states. These store positions are modelled.

## What we tested
| Hypothesis | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Short deliveries drive the miss | 5 of 8 missed lines short; fill 68.6% on short lines | Confirmed |
| Recent fall | 95.5% → 79.5%; scorecard low 87.3% in week 18 | Confirmed |
| Who owns the misses | 0% of units short are Baby Mart's | Supplier |
| NSW DC concentration | 80.2% of units short | Confirmed |
| Crawler Nappies concentration | 75.4% of units short | Confirmed |
| Planner override | No override-sized lines | Ruled out |
| Lead time / lane | 7.7% of lines late | Ruled out |
| Rush orders | 1 of 3 late lines (33.3%) | Inconclusive |
| Problem across all suppliers | Unit fill 93.5% vs 96.5% for other suppliers | Inconclusive |
| Shelves emptying | 12 NSW stores SHORT | Confirmed |

## What to do
These are recommendations; I haven't changed anything.
1. **Supply:** Recover Rascal + Friends Crawler Nappies for the 12 short NSW stores. To start that with the Stockout Recovery builder, use: *"Rascal + Friends Crawler Nappies are out of stock in 12 NSW stores. Get them back on shelf."*
2. **Buying:** Review Rascal & Co's performance on short-shipping and get a committed allocation and recovery date for Crawler Nappies.
3. **Category:** Consider substitute cover in NSW until fill recovers.

There's no need to change the 3PL setup. Lateness isn't the problem, and a 3PL isn't viable on this lane.
